ProfessorReserve_Text_Npc0.en: Every trainer starts with one. Here\nthey roam free.
ProfessorReserve_Text_Npc0.fr: Chaque dresseur commence avec un.\nIci ils vagabondent librement.

ProfessorReserve_Text_Npc1.en: I come here to remember my first\npartner.
ProfessorReserve_Text_Npc1.fr: Je viens ici pour me souvenir de\nmon premier partenaire.

ProfessorReserve_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: A RARE CANDY for my research. I\nwill give you a PP MAX.
ProfessorReserve_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Un BONBON RARE pour ma recherche.\nJe te donnerai un PP MAX.

ProfessorReserve_Text_Quest0_Done.en: Excellent! Here is a PP MAX.

ProfessorReserve_Text_Quest0_MissT.fr: Un BONBON RARE, s'il vous plaît.

ProfessorReserve_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
ProfessorReserve_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reviens.

ProfessorReserve_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

ProfessorReserve_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
ProfessorReserve_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.

ProfessorReserve_Text_TopazeFindFull.en: Something shines here, but your BAG\nis full.
ProfessorReserve_Text_TopazeFindFull.fr: Quelque chose brille ici, mais ton\nSAC est plein.
